channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran warns neighbours against joining US economic war
item.description: Official says any state joining US would be considered an enemy and Tehran would target their interests in retaliation.

item.title: Iran threatens countries that join US ‘economic D-Day’
item.description: Iran warns that countries joining the US economic war against Iran will face ‘tit-for-tat’ action.

item.title: Iran warns nearby nations against joining US ‘economic war’ efforts
item.description: The warning comes as US President Donald Trump threatens to isolate Iran economically to weaken its government.

item.title: Iran grants permission for some Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz
item.description: Iraqi President Nizar Amidi says his country's territory will not be used to launch attacks against any other state.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill two and injure others as Gaza attacks continue
item.description: Israeli drone attack targeted a family in the central city of Deir el-Balah, killing one person and wounding others.

item.title: Envoy says Israel did not give the US notice before strikes on Syrian base
item.description: US official Tom Barrack has criticised Israel for failing to give his country adequate warning, a claim Tel Aviv denies.

item.title: Seven killed, including two police officers, in UK ‘wrong-side’ car crash
item.description: Accident follows similar crashes in Ireland where police highlighted social media trend driving in opposite direction.

item.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
item.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

item.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
item.description: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

item.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
item.description: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.
